title: Using a Popup with Wayland without transient_to_focus crashes Godot Editor
body:
### Tested versions

Reproductible in:
- 4.7.1
- master (159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b)

### System information

Computer 1: PopOs 24.04 Cosmic (wayland),   Computer2: Debian 13 KDE Plasma 6.3 (Wayland)

### Issue description

With Godot Editor on Linux with wayland renderer:
- Create a scene with a Popup as root
- transient_to_focused is false (by default, keep it that way)
- Open that popup from GDScript
-> Godot crashes

The assert [`ERR_FAIL_COND(root_id == DisplayServerEnums::INVALID_WINDOW_ID);` fails ](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/display_server_wayland.cpp#L878).

This is the case because, when the popup is created ([`Window::_make_window`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b/scene/main/window.cpp#L704)):
- [`_make_transient()`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b/scene/main/window.cpp#L708) is not called, as `transient_to_focused` is false. So the `transient_parent` property is `null`
- [When the window is created](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b/scene/main/window.cpp#L734), an invalid id is assigned to `parent_id`, because `transient_parent` is `null`
- [On show](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b/scene/main/window.cpp#L757), the method [`DisplayServerWayland::show_window`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/display_server_wayland.cpp#L858) expect the window to be in a valid tree [(ie has a valid parent)](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/159701651ad44335691dcbd632d8074307074c7b/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/display_server_wayland.cpp#L878). But it has not been set yet, the assertion fails

#### Workaround
If the `transient_to_focused` property is `true`, then all works fine.

#### Expected behavior

It depends on what is possible technically, so from most preferred to less preferred:
1. No crashes
2. No choices about `transient_to_focused` on Wayland
3. An error indicating it should be `true`

### Steps to reproduce

See issue description
